lina (Docs): i'm about to open a PR to disambiguate batching vs kv-prefetch on the Optimize Toolkit page. found one vague sentence and a dead link.
ash (Eng): please show a tiny py + go example that toggles prefetch_window and uses BatchGenerate. users need explicit numbers.
yuko (ML): add a quant note: certain 4-bit configs don't preserve fp16 kv behavior 1; recommend testing with the sample eval.
sam (DevEx): also include a one-line troubleshooting tip for streaming + batching interaction. that trips up folks.
lina (Docs): plan: docs PR + examples PR with a minimal perf script. docs will: 1) replace broken link, 2) add py/go snippets with prefetch_window=32, 3) add short-prefix threshold note (<8 tokens), 4) call out mem tradeoffs and quant recommendation.
linkbot: reminder: link-check will run when PR is opened.
ash (Eng): tiny nit: avoid words like "aggressive"; use numbers (e.g., prefetch_window=32). also mention Dedicated can tune prefetch in deployment config.
yuko (ML): wording suggestion: "for workloads relying on prefix caching, prefer 8-bit/mixed precision; verify 4-bit profiles with the provided eval set."
lina (Docs): thanks all 1; i'll tag ash/yuko/sam for reviews and open PRs tonight. sam can do a style pass after merge.
